users.title: Users
users.intro: Disable blocks a person without deleting anything; you can enable them again later. Delete removes the account and all its data permanently. You cannot change yourself, other admins or the demo account.

users.deleteBody: The account and all their data (trips, groups, purposes, plans, share links) are deleted permanently. This cannot be undone. They need a new invitation to come back.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Switches and limits you can change here without a restart. Order: admin value, then environment variable, then default. A change takes effect at once on this instance; other instances catch up within 30 seconds. Secrets (API keys) are never stored here.
